checks.explanation: The predicted roughly 30-year horizon (to around 2051) has not elapsed.
Pandemic-era learning loss was well documented as significant and persistent through the mid-2020s, but a full generational (multi-decade) consequence is not yet provable.
China's demographic decline and elevated inflation both materialized as predicted, but a clear US Rust Belt reindustrialization from this dynamic is only weakly supported.
By 2024, AWS revenue (over $100 billion annually) remained far larger than Amazon's advertising business (about $56 billion), contradicting the prediction.
The predicted end-of-decade (2029) breakup has not yet been reached.
Antitrust actions against major tech platforms (e.g., the Google search antitrust ruling) have advanced, but no major platform has actually been broken up.
The predicted roughly-2029 horizon has not yet been reached.
